functions.description: Load GPC archive and assign model animations
functions.notes: Everything matches (frame layout, registers, call order, pool refs) except the tail: target return paths each carry their own 'mov r0, r4' (fail arm: 'mov r4,#0 ... mov r0,r4; b epilogue', success arm: 'mov r4,#1 ... mov r0,r4'), mine shares one 'mov r0,r4' at the join (4 bytes short). Using separate 'return result;' in each arm makes mwcc constant-fold result (mov r0,#0/#1, no r4, 8 bytes short); a single join return keeps r4 but does not duplicate the mov. Tried int/bool/uchar/short/uint result, result initialised at top, result=ok, merged tail (24 bytes short). Also: SetField78/SetField7a only matched with extern C decls taking unsigned int (header ushort params add an extra lsl/lsr on the hi half), which may not meet the quality bar; ObjectArchiveLoadInfo.unk_10 =1 is the 'one' flag; one loadInfo declared once and ClearEightWords called twice.
